class.name: Analytics
class.brief_description: Opt-in analytics singleton for editor demographics and game session events.
class.description: [Analytics] queues JSON events and optionally POSTs them to an ingest endpoint. Editor builds compiled with [code]editor_analytics=yes[/code] record demographic/usage events after consent. Export templates compiled with [code]analytics=yes[/code] expose a small game SDK ([method track], session start/end). Editor [method get_app_id], [method get_build_id], and ingest URL are baked at compile time ([code]editor_app_id[/code], [code]editor_build_id[/code], [code]editor_analytics_endpoint[/code]) and cannot be changed from CLI, environment, or Editor Settings. If [code]editor_app_id[/code] is omitted, the editor uses [code]custom_blazium_engine[/code]. If [code]editor_build_id[/code] is omitted, the editor uses the engine git hash. An empty editor ingest URL disables collection and sending (no queue growth). Exported games read [member ProjectSettings.application/analytics/app_id], [member ProjectSettings.application/analytics/build_id], and [member ProjectSettings.application/analytics/endpoint]. Consent priority is CLI [code]--analytics=[/code], then [code]BLAZIUM_ANALYTICS_CONSENT[/code], then Editor Settings or [method set_consent]. Anonymous mode (default) omits [code]device_uid[/code]; identified mode sends [method OS.get_unique_id]. See [method get_resolved_config].

method.name: flush
method.description: POSTs queued events to the resolved endpoint. Emits [signal flush_succeeded] or [signal flush_failed]. An empty endpoint leaves the queue on disk and logs that the flush was dropped.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the product id sent on every event and as [code]X-App-Id[/code] on flush. In the editor this is the SCons-baked value. In exported games it comes from Project Settings. Shared with [method CrashReporter.get_app_id]. There is no engine CLI override.

method.name: get_app_version
method.description: Returns the resolved product version sent on every event.

method.name: get_build_channel
method.description: Returns the resolved build channel ([code]dev[/code], [code]beta[/code], [code]release[/code], or custom).

method.name: get_build_id
method.description: Returns the build id sent on every event and as [code]X-Build-Id[/code] on flush. In the editor this is the SCons-baked value. In exported games it comes from Project Settings. Shared with [method CrashReporter.get_build_id]. There is no engine CLI override.

method.name: get_consent
method.description: Returns [code]unset[/code], [code]accepted[/code], or [code]declined[/code] after CLI, environment, and persisted settings.

method.name: get_device_uid
method.description: Returns [method OS.get_unique_id] when identified, or an empty string when anonymous.

method.name: get_queue_size
method.description: Returns the number of events waiting in the on-disk JSONL queue.

method.name: get_resolved_config
method.description: Returns identity, consent, endpoint, and queue path. Editor identity and ingest URL are compile-time only; an empty editor URL disables collection. Game identity and URL come from Project Settings.

method.name: identify
method.description: Stores a game user id attached to later events. No-op in anonymous mode.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the [Analytics] module is compiled in.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when events may be queued (feature flag plus consent).

method.name: set_anonymous
method.description: Sets anonymous mode for this process. New events omit or include [code]device_uid[/code] accordingly; already queued events keep the mode they were created with.

method.name: set_consent
method.description: Accepts or declines analytics. Editor builds persist this in Editor Settings.

method.name: set_user_properties
method.description: Merges game user properties into later events. No-op in anonymous mode.

method.name: track
method.description: Queues [param event] with [param properties] plus automatic runtime context. Editor and game contexts use separate property sets.

signal.name: flush_failed
signal.description: Emitted when [method flush] cannot POST queued events.

signal.name: flush_succeeded
signal.description: Emitted after a successful flush. [param count] is the number of events sent.
